name: XUSD
oneLiner: XUSD is BabelFish's Rootstock dollar token, minted 1:1 from a basket of bridged stablecoins (DLLR, USDT, USDC, DAI) with basket-balance constraints.
collateral: Rootstock basket of accepted stablecoins, dominated by DLLR with bridged USDT, USDC, DAI variants, and small DOC exposure
pegMechanism: BabelFish mints XUSD 1:1 from accepted stablecoins and allows redemption into accepted bAssets, subject to basket-balance constraints and balancing fees

reserves.name: DOC and other Rootstock stablecoin dust

mintAuthority.summary: XUSD is BabelFish's meta-stablecoin aggregator on Rootstock: any user mints XUSD 1:1 by depositing an accepted bAsset stablecoin (DLLR, USDT, USDC, DAI, DOC) and redeems back, subject to basket-balance constraints and fees; the accepted-asset set and parameters are curated by the BabelFish FISH-token DAO.

controls.label: BabelFish masset (XUSD) mint/redeem aggregator contract
controls.evidence: BabelFish mints XUSD 1:1 from accepted bAsset stablecoins and allows redemption back to accepted bAssets via the basket contract; minting is user-driven against deposited collateral, not a discretionary minter, subject to basket-balance limits and balancing fees.

controls.label: BabelFish FISH DAO (accepted-asset and parameter governance)
controls.evidence: FISH governance token holders vote (with DAO consensus / forum process) on which stablecoins are accepted and on basket/lending parameters, tuning the mint route rather than minting directly.

review.evidence: BabelFish/Sovryn docs describe XUSD as a 1:1 stablecoin aggregator where users mint/redeem against a hedged basket of accepted bAssets under basket-balance constraints, with the accepted-asset set and parameters governed by the FISH-token DAO; no centralized discretionary minter is described.
review.sourceFreeRationale: User-collateralized basket mint and FISH-DAO parameter governance taken from BabelFish/Sovryn docs; the on-chain masset-manager admin/timelock and governance executor were not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain XUSD masset-manager admin/proxy owner and the FISH DAO executor/timelock controlling accepted bAssets.
